The firm is hosting a large regional private wealth event in Dubai aimed at courting Middle Eastern high-net-worth clients. items.t: Blackstone (BX) Stock Looks Fairly Valued Following Its 25% Slide
items.sum: Blackstone has had a tough year in the market, with the stock down 25.4% year to date. That slide puts fresh focus on a basic question for investors: Is the current share price a fair reflection of the returns the asset manager earns on the capital it deploys across real estate, credit, infrastructure and private equity?
